sentences.da: Solen står op over Sønderborg, og en fugl synger i et stort træ.
sentences.en: The sun rises over Sønderborg, and a bird sings in a big tree.

sentences.da: Huset er hvidt, og døren er rød.
sentences.en: The house is white, and the door is red.

sentences.da: Der er et lille køkken med et bord, en stol og en gammel lampe.
sentences.en: There is a small kitchen with a table, a chair and an old lamp.

sentences.da: Mor laver mad, mens far drikker kaffe ved vinduet.
sentences.en: Mum is making food, while dad drinks coffee by the window.

sentences.da: Barnet spiser et æble og drikker mælk.
sentences.en: The child eats an apple and drinks milk.

sentences.da: På bordet står ost, smør, salt og et æg.
sentences.en: On the table there is cheese, butter, salt and an egg.

sentences.da: Hunden løber ud ad døren, mens en kat sover stadig på en seng.
sentences.en: The dog runs out of the door, while a cat still sleeps on a bed.

sentences.da: Deres værelse er lille, men vinduet er stort.
sentences.en: Their room is small, but the window is big.

sentences.da: Pigen har en blomst i hånden, og drengen har mistet en tand.
sentences.en: The girl has a flower in her hand, and the boy has lost a tooth.

sentences.da: Hun har langt hår, en lille næse og en glad mund.
sentences.en: She has long hair, a small nose and a happy mouth.

sentences.da: Han lukker det ene øje og sætter en hat på hovedet.
sentences.en: He closes one eye and puts a hat on his head.

sentences.da: Katten sidder ved hans ben, mens han har ondt i en fod.
sentences.en: The cat sits by his leg, while his foot hurts.

sentences.da: Drengen har en bold under armen, og faren drikker en øl.
sentences.en: The boy has a ball under his arm, and the father drinks a beer.

sentences.da: Pigen peger med en finger mod et sort fly på en klar himmel.
sentences.en: The girl points with a finger at a black plane in a clear sky.

sentences.da: Hjertet banker, fordi familien skal rejse i dag.
sentences.en: Her heart beats, because the family is travelling today.

sentences.da: De går ned ad en gade midt i en gammel by.
sentences.en: They walk down a street in the middle of an old town.

sentences.da: En ung kvinde og en gammel mand venter ved en kirke.
sentences.en: A young woman and an old man wait by a church.

sentences.da: I en butik køber de kød, fisk og grøntsager.
sentences.en: In a shop they buy meat, fish and vegetables.

sentences.da: De tager også en kartoffel, sukker og en stor kage.
sentences.en: They also take a potato, sugar and a big cake.

sentences.da: Far henter penge i en bank, fordi han vil købe en bog.
sentences.en: Dad fetches money at a bank, because he wants to buy a book.

sentences.da: Mor arbejder på et hospital, men i dag har hun fri.
sentences.en: Mum works at a hospital, but today she is off.

sentences.da: Hendes bror er lærer på en skole.
sentences.en: Her brother is a teacher at a school.

sentences.da: Hans søster kører en rød bil, og hendes søn har en cykel.
sentences.en: His sister drives a red car, and her son has a bicycle.

sentences.da: En hest står i en park ved vandet.
sentences.en: A horse stands in a park by the water.

sentences.da: Deres datter og en ven læser en bog, hvis det regner.
sentences.en: Their daughter and a friend read a book if it rains.

sentences.da: En aften i sidste uge faldt der sne over hele byen.
sentences.en: One evening last week snow fell over the whole town.

sentences.da: Nu venter et tog, og en bus kører forbi.
sentences.en: Now a train is waiting, and a bus drives past.

sentences.da: Fra vinduet ser de stranden og et stort hav.
sentences.en: From the window they see the beach and a big sea.

sentences.da: Det bliver nat, og man kan se månen og en klar stjerne.
sentences.en: Night falls, and you can see the moon and a bright star.

sentences.da: De elsker at rejse, selvom rejsen er lang.
sentences.en: They love to travel, even though the journey is long.

sentences.da: Casey er glad, fordi kufferten er fuld af ord.
sentences.en: Casey is happy, because the suitcase is full of words.
